scope: Bounded re-review of REV01/REV02 fixes only; no broadened audit.

findings.title: Valid compressed Google response rejected by wire/decoded length mismatch
findings.confirmed_by: google_gzip_result.json; actual urllib3 gzip decoding in a network-disabled container
findings.trigger: Content-Length=60 encoded bytes and629 decoded JSON bytes
findings.impact: OAuth cert/token reads reject a valid compressed response, preventing Google sign-in.
findings.smallest_fix: Read decoded content to EOF under existing byte/time caps without comparing decoded count to encoded Content-Length; preserve encoded-length cap and urllib3 encoded-stream truncation validation; add gzip/truncated regressions.

closure.source_review: Decoded stream now reads to EOF; encoded Content-Length remains a wire-size upper bound while decoded bytes retain their independent128KiB/time cap. Incorrect encoded-vs-decoded equality removed.
closure.reproduction: google_gzip_after.json: result accepted, body_matches true,629decoded bytes/60encoded bytes, provider_calls0

findings.title: New financial workers are not dispatched by actual maintenance loop
findings.confirmed_by: Current source branch still raises for refund_reconcile/refund_review and lacks subscription_reconcile.
findings.impact: Approved refunds and existing cancellation jobs cannot execute through scheduled maintenance even with qualified configuration.
findings.smallest_fix: Dispatch refund_reconcile and subscription_reconcile to their existing workers after authority checks land; retain unsupported/unreviewed obligations as blocked and test run_due_jobs with mocked provider.

closure.source_review: refund_review/refund_reconcile dispatch to existing gated process_refund_job; subscription_reconcile dispatches to process_subscription_job. Unreviewed/unsupported refund/mandate/provider cases classify as blocked.
closure.runtime_test_status: Parent/implementer focused tests running separately; no new full-suite pass claimed by this receipt.

reviewed_authority_followup.summary: Queued cancellation records exact provider, merchant mode and provider resource ID; worker rejects absent or mismatched bindings before adapter construction. Owner, cancellation intent and mode checks remain; earned periods and mandate authority are preserved.

other_review_result: No additional concrete blocking financial/media authority regression found in the reviewed paths. This is not an exhaustive security assessment or actual provider qualification.
result: PASS: both concrete findings closed by source reread; original gzip reproduction now accepted
